evidence.finding: A complete UUID-shape scan found nine residual task identifiers across six records and six JSON finding fields. No private user-root, Documents-root, Codex-state, file-URI, or email residual was found.

The v1 task-ID regular expression required word boundaries. Each missed UUID was concatenated directly after prose such as thread, task, or parent-thread, so the leading boundary test failed even though the UUID shape was complete.
Methodology record 21779952 is published under concept 10.5281/zenodo.21124403 with 100 files / 4990612147 bytes. It remains immutable adverse history after the v2 successor.
Replication record 21779957 is published under concept 10.5281/zenodo.20461174 with 65 files / 9013124 bytes. It remains immutable adverse history after the v2 successor.
